LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.3: Phonological Awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Phonological Awareness
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What can you do to improve your ability to pronounce words accurately?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Phonological Awareness.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What can you do to improve your ability to pronounce words accurately?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• apply appropriate stress and intonation for fluency

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
